#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FastIn {
    std::stringstream ss;
    void readNextLine() {
        std::string line;
        if (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(line);
        }
    }
    std::string getNext() {
        while (!(ss >> std::ws), ss.eof() || ss.peek() == EOF) {
            readNextLine();
        }
        std::string token;
        ss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int getInt() {
        return std::stoi(getNext());
    }
    long long getLong() {
        return std::stoll(getNext());
    }
};

class Processor {
public:
    std::ostream& out;
    FastIn& fi;

    Processor(std::ostream& out, FastIn& fi) : out(out), fi(fi) {}

    void process(int all, int t) {
        int n=fi.getInt();
        int mod=fi.getInt();

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> dp(n, std::vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for(int i=1; i<n; i++){
            for(int j=0; j<dp[0].size(); j++){
                for(int c=0; c<=i; c++){
                    if(j - c >= 0){
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i-1][j-c];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if(dp[i][j]==0) dp[i][j]+=mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> prefixSum(n, std::vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for(int i=0; i<dp.size(); i++){
            long long sum=0;
            for(int j=0; j<dp[0].size(); j++){
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if(sum==0) sum+=mod;
                prefixSum[i][j]=sum;
            }
        }

        std::vector<long long> factorial(251001, 1);
        for(int i=1; i<factorial.size(); i++){
            factorial[i] = (factorial[i-1]*i) % mod;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> nCr(501, std::vector<long long>(501, 0));
        nCr[0][0]=1;
        for(int i=1; i<=500; i++){
            nCr[i][0]=1;
            for(int j=1; j<=i; j++){
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long long totalRes=0;
        for(int i=0; i<=n-2; i++){
            int cnt=n-i;
            int pre=n - cnt;
            long long comb = (nCr[n][pre] * factorial[pre]) % mod;
            long long total=0;
            std::vector<long long>& last=dp[cnt-2];
            long long ssum=0;
            long long totalSum=0;
            for(int j=2; j<dp[0].size(); j++){
                total += prefixSum[cnt-2][j-2] * (cnt-1);
                total %= mod;

                long long val=last[j]*total;
                totalRes+=val;
                totalRes%=mod;

                ssum+=prefixSum[cnt-2][j-2];
                if(j - cnt - 1 >= 0) ssum -= prefixSum[cnt-2][j - cnt - 1];
                ssum = (ssum + mod) % mod;

                total -= ssum;
                total = (total + mod) % mod;
            }
            totalRes += (prefixSum[cnt-2][0] * comb) % mod;
            totalRes %= mod;
        }
        out << totalRes << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    FastIn fi;
    Processor p(std::cout, fi);
    int T=1;
    for(int t=0; t<T; t++) {
        p.process(T, t);
    }
    return 0;
}
